title: Privacy **Policy**
intro: This Privacy Policy explains how [SMMGen](/about-us) collects, uses, and protects your personal information while using our [SMM Panel](/) services. By accessing SMMGen, you agree to the data practices outlined in this policy.
contactNote: If you have any questions about this policy, contact us at support@smmgen.com or visit smmgen.com/contact-us.
body:
## Who We Are

SMMGen is a global SMM panel platform operated at smmgen.com. We provide social media marketing services including followers, likes, views, comments, and engagement across platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Telegram, and more.

We have been operating since 2018 and serve users in over 100 countries worldwide. All services are delivered using public profile links only. We never request your social media account passwords.

For all privacy-related queries, contact us at smmgen.com/contact-us.

## What Information We Collect

### Information You Give Us Directly

When you create an account or use our services, we collect the following information from you directly.

### Account registration data:

Your email address and password when you sign up at smmgen.com/signup. We use this to create and manage your account.

### Order data:

The public profile or post URLs you submit when placing orders. We use these to process and deliver your services. We do not store social media passwords or login credentials under any circumstance.

### Payment data:

When you add funds to your account, payment is processed through third-party payment gateways including PayPal, Visa, Mastercard, and cryptocurrency processors. SMMGen does not store your full card details on our servers. Payment processors handle and encrypt all sensitive financial data.

### Support communications

When you contact us through smmgen.com/contact-us or via support tickets, we store the content of those communications to help resolve your queries and improve our service.

### Information We Collect Automatically

When you visit smmgen.com, our systems automatically collect certain technical data.

### Log data:

Your IP address, browser type, browser version, pages you visit, the time and date of your visit, and the time spent on each page.

### Device data:

Information about the device you use to access SMMGen, including operating system, screen resolution, and device type.

### Cookies and tracking data:

We use cookies to maintain your login session, remember your preferences, and analyze site traffic. See the Cookies section below for full details.

### Information From Third Parties

We may receive basic information about you from third-party services if you choose to log in or connect through a third-party authentication provider such as Google. This is limited to the data that provider shares with us during the login process, typically your name and email address.

## How We Use Your Information

SMMGen uses the information we collect for the following purposes.

### To provide and process your orders.

Your account data, order URLs, and balance information are used to process service orders and deliver results through our platform.

### To manage your account.

We use your email address to send account confirmations, order updates, and important service notifications.

### To process payments.

Your deposit and transaction data is used to maintain your account balance and process fund additions through our payment partners.

### To provide customer support.

When you contact us, we use your communication history to understand and resolve your issue efficiently.

### To improve our platform.

Aggregate, anonymized data about how users interact with smmgen.com helps us improve the dashboard, service catalog, and user experience.

### To send service communications.

We may send you emails about your orders, account security, or important changes to our services. These are not marketing emails. You cannot opt out of essential account communications.

### To prevent fraud and enforce our terms.

We use account and usage data to detect unusual activity, prevent abuse of our platform, and enforce our terms and conditions.

## How We Store and Protect Your Data

### Security Measures

SMMGen uses SSL encryption across the entire smmgen.com domain, including all dashboard screens and payment pages. All data transmitted between your browser and our servers is encrypted end to end.
We use industry-standard security practices including firewalled servers, access controls, and regular security reviews to protect the data we hold.
Your password is stored in a hashed format. We cannot read your password. If you lose access, use the password reset function on the login page.

### Data Retention

We retain your account data for as long as your account remains active. If you request account deletion, we remove your personal data from our active systems within 30 days, except where we are required to retain certain records for legal or financial compliance purposes.
Order history records may be retained for up to 12 months for dispute resolution and financial reporting purposes.
Support communications are retained for up to 24 months to provide context for future queries.

### Where Your Data Is Stored

SMMGen's servers are located in data centers operating under industry-standard physical and digital security controls. We process data globally to serve users across 100+ countries. By using smmgen.com, you consent to your data being stored and processed on servers that may be located outside your country of residence.

## Cookies

### What Cookies We Use

SMMGen uses the following types of cookies on smmgen.com.

### Essential cookies:

These are required for the website to function. They manage your login session and keep you authenticated across pages. You cannot disable essential cookies without breaking core site functionality.

### Analytics cookies:

We use analytics tools to understand how users navigate smmgen.com. This data is aggregated and anonymized. It helps us identify which pages perform well and which need improvement.

### Preference cookies:

These remember your settings, such as language or display preferences, so you do not have to reset them on every visit.

### How to Control Cookies

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block, delete, or alert you before storing cookies. Blocking essential cookies will affect your ability to log in and use the platform.
You can also opt out of analytics tracking through your browser's privacy settings or by using a browser extension that blocks tracking scripts.

## Sharing Your Information

SMMGen does not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties for their own marketing purposes. We share your data only in the following limited circumstances.

### Payment processors.

When you add funds, your transaction data is shared with the relevant payment gateway (PayPal, Visa, Mastercard, or a crypto processor) to complete the transaction. Each processor operates under its own privacy policy.

### Service providers.

We use third-party tools for analytics, server infrastructure, and support. These providers process data on our behalf and are contractually required to handle it in accordance with applicable privacy laws.

### Legal requirements.

We may disclose your data if required to do so by law, court order, or in response to a lawful request from a government authority.

### Business transfers.

If SMMGen is involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, user data may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will notify affected users before such a transfer takes place.

We never share your public order URLs with third parties beyond what is necessary to process and deliver your order.

## Your Rights Over Your Data

Depending on your country of residence, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data.

### Right to access.

You can request a copy of the personal data SMMGen holds about you.

### Right to correction.

You can request that we correct inaccurate or incomplete data in your account.

### Right to deletion.

You can request that we delete your personal data, subject to any legal retention requirements.

### Right to restriction.

You can request that we limit how we process your data in certain circumstances.

### Right to data portability.

You can request a copy of your data in a structured, machine-readable format.

### Right to object.

You can object to certain types of processing, including analytics and profiling.

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at smmgen.com/contact-us or email support@smmgen.com. We respond to all data requests within 30 days.

## Children's Privacy

SMMGen's services are intended for users aged 18 and above. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under the age of 18.
If you believe a child under 18 has created an account on smmgen.com, contact us at support@smmgen.com and we will delete the account and all associated data promptly.

## Third-Party Links

smmgen.com may contain links to external websites, including social media platforms and payment processors. Once you leave smmgen.com, this Privacy Policy no longer applies. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of any third-party site.
We recommend reviewing the privacy policy of any external site before providing your personal information.

## Changes to This Privacy Policy

We update this Privacy Policy when our practices change or when required by law. We publish all updates on this page with a revised "Last updated" date at the top.
For significant changes that affect how we use your personal data, we will notify registered users by email before the change takes effect.
We recommend checking this page periodically to stay informed of any updates.

## How to Contact Us

For any questions, concerns, or requests related to this Privacy Policy, contact the SMMGen team through the following channels.

We aim to respond to all privacy-related queries within 48 hours.
